gaps.title: Missing protocol access control for Researchers
gaps.jtbd: When a user accesses protocols, I want access to be restricted to Researchers and above, so that the archive role model is enforced as specified.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given an authenticated user, When they attempt to access protocols, Then access is granted only if their role is RESEARCHER, EPIDEMIOLOGIST, or ADMIN.
gaps.reason: literal brief requirement: 'Исследователь / Аспирант с правом доступа к протоколам'

gaps.title: Missing pagination on strains catalog endpoint
gaps.jtbd: When fetching the catalog of strains, I want the results to be paginated, so that the endpoint does not suffer from performance degradation as data grows.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given a request to /api/v1/strains, When returning the list of accessible strains, Then the response is paginated (accepting page and size parameters).
gaps.reason: domain-standard expectation: a public list endpoint usually needs pagination

gaps.title: Insecure authorization via fuzzy substring matching
gaps.jtbd: When enforcing course-based access control, I want to use strict exact matching, so that users do not inadvertently gain access to unauthorized resources due to partial string matches.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given a comma-separated list of user courses, When executing the authorization JPQL query, Then the courses are split into a Java List and matched using a strict IN clause instead of LIKE %course%.
gaps.reason: domain-standard expectation: authorizations involving comma-separated strings must use exact matches rather than insecure fuzzy substring matching
